description: Read a known public URL as markdown. Not search: use google_search (serp); for eBay/Zillow use their tools. Required: url. Optional: max_tokens truncates and links full text; async=true returns a job_id to poll.

async.description: Return a pending job immediately; otherwise wait up to 25 seconds.

challenge_mode.description: For pages that answer with a browser verification check. 10 credits; not combinable with premium or render_js.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse to avoid duplicate jobs and charges.

job_id.description: Poll a previous scrape job. Keep the original url; no new scrape or charge.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of markdown characters to return.

max_tokens.description: Optional token limit (~4 characters per token); replaces max_chars. Over it, text is cut and content_id/content_url fetch the full page for 1 hour with the same key, at no extra charge.

premium.description: Premium mode (10 credits): retry with this when a page comes back blocked or empty.

render_js.description: Whether to render the page with JavaScript before scraping.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS page URL to scrape.

name: scrape_url
title: Read URL
